question: How does the divine appear as benefactor, tree, and deer in this salutation?
premises: The divine is addressed as benefactor of the world.
The divine is addressed as a tree.
The divine is addressed as a deer.
inference: The divine manifests as universal benefactor and in natural forms.
plain_english: Obeisance to the benefactor of the world, obeisance to the tree, obeisance to the deer.
